ambient_events: The hand pump squeaks twice and settles.
Water ticks through the filter drums, unhurried.
A glass jar of the finished water sits on the shelf beside a jar of what came in, kept side by side to make a point.
description: A wet little room of filter drums and hand pumps where the Watch make their own water. Three barrels in series, sand and charcoal and something the quartermaster won't name, and a brass tap at the end that runs clear. They do not draw from the city main. A meter that turns is a meter that tells the machine somebody is alive down here.
name: The Tap
